articles.title: The 75-Year Army Deal That Could Reshape America's Rare Earth Supply
articles.summary: The U.S. Army has partnered with REalloys to establish the first commercial rare earth processing operation on a U.S. military installation. This strategic move aims to secure a crucial domestic supply chain for rare earth elements, vital for advanced defence technologies. The initiative significantly enhances national security, reduces reliance on foreign sources, and bolsters the defence industrial base for future military needs.

articles.title: Beyond the gateway: West Bengal has the products, but needs an export strategy
articles.summary: West Bengal's goods exports are projected to fall below 2021-22 levels by 2025-26, despite its strategic advantages like ports and borders. This highlights a critical need for an updated and organized export policy. The state must focus on upgrading infrastructure and processes to leverage its potential, thereby boosting its trade performance and contributing to national economic growth.

articles.title: FReeper Canteen ~ Road Trip: Naval Station Newport, Rhode Island ~ 10 NOV 2026
articles.summary: Naval Station Newport, situated in Rhode Island, is a prominent United States Navy base. This vital installation serves as a crucial operational and training hub for various US Navy commands and personnel, emphasizing strategic maritime operations. For an SSB aspirant, understanding such bases highlights the critical infrastructure supporting naval power and national defense, showcasing commitment to readiness and operational effectiveness.

articles.title: What China's nuclear turn means for India
articles.summary: A nuclear-powered Type 094A Jin-class ballistic missile submarine, belonging to the Chinese People's Liberation Army Navy (PLAN), was observed during a military display in the South China Sea in April 2018. This sighting underscores China's growing naval capabilities and its assertive presence in the strategically vital and often contested South China Sea region, indicating its significant maritime power projection.

articles.title: A decade of 'make in India' in defence
articles.summary: The Advanced Light Helicopter (ALH) Dhruv, indigenously designed and developed by Hindustan Aeronautics Limited (HAL), marks a crucial milestone in India's defence self-reliance. This multi-role helicopter significantly enhances the operational capabilities of the Indian armed forces. Its successful indigenous development by HAL underscores India's growing technological prowess and commitment to strengthening national security through domestic manufacturing.

articles.title: Fantasy Football Waiver Wire: Justin Boone's top defenses to stream in Week 10
articles.summary: The article details Week 10 of the 2026 fantasy football season, marking its halfway point. It emphasizes the critical lineup decisions approaching for participants as playoffs near, highlighting the strategic choices necessary for success in their respective fantasy leagues.

articles.title: REBECCA GRANT: Jensen Huang owes America an apology, and Nvidia owes investors answers
articles.summary: Reports indicate Nvidia CEO, Jensen Huang, allegedly fell victim to an espionage 'honeytrap,' a classic spy tactic. This incident highlights potential vulnerabilities faced by high-profile figures in critical technology sectors. While details remain limited from this excerpt, it underscores the persistent threat of intelligence operations targeting influential individuals, potentially for strategic information.
